cohort: The study analyzed 92 singleton extremely preterm infants born between 22+0 and 25+6 weeks of gestation.
finding: Delivery mode had no significant effect on survival, though intraventricular hemorrhage tended to occur more frequently after vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Delivery mode had no significant effect on survival, but intraventricular hemorrhage tended to occur more frequently after vaginal birth.
